biography.plain_text: James R. “Jim” Wehr is a Springfield, Missouri businessman whose family developed Aaron’s Automotive Products into a substantial engine and transmission remanufacturing business. Working with his father, founder Bob Wehr, he helped expand the company before its sale in 1994. The family subsequently concentrated on owning and developing local commercial property.

long_biography.plain_text:
A lasting part of James R. “Jim” Wehr’s contribution to Springfield is Wehr Band Hall at Missouri State University. He and his father financed the facility after years of hiring band director Jerry Hoover for company events and following the university’s ensembles on tour.

Their gift gave the expanding band programme dedicated premises, with rehearsal rooms, a music library and recording facilities. The university authorised the family to build on campus, and the hall was built in 1996. It became the home of the Missouri State Pride Bands, providing space for large rehearsals alongside individual practice and percussion work.
